name: jenkins
description: Blazemeter blazect Jenkins knowledge — trigger a multibranch branch build with PUSH_TO_GCR and PERFORM_WHITESOURCE_SCAN, gate on green (unit-test/prisms/mend), fix-forward, and never gate on the slow API_TESTS-CI suite; plus deploy a green branch to a denv environment via the shared 'Deploy environment' job (GIRO_BRANCH + USERNAME) and gate on that deploy. Reusable by any flow that gates on a Blazemeter CI build or denv deploy.
